race.comment: AMARILLO SKY (1) gets the nod on the strength of two sound runs this campaign and looks ready to peak third-up. He was safely held after leading at Bendigo, but his Tatura fourth over 1000m had merit and he rates well off the recent exposed form, with the step to 1590m the main point to prove. STYLE GUIDE (7) is a genuine danger despite a long-standing maiden record, having been within just over three lengths at both Moe and Tatura and bringing a 2kg claim into a race lacking depth. RIVERLEA PRINCE (4) comes off a disappointing tenth at this venue over 2000m, but his record of four placings from seven starts around this distance keeps him firmly in the place-and-rough-win discussion if he can rebound. MIRRAWAY (6) kept coming only to just miss when fresh from a spell last start over 1400m at Wodonga. Sure to derive great benefit from that run. Beautifully placed and is sure to be there at the finish.
